prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1241; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left-turn lane at an intersection in League City, Texas, when the collision occurred. Driver 1 reported that the vehicle was struck by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through the intersection. Driver 2 gave a statement consistent with that account. Two independent witnesses at the scene and photographs taken by responding officers support the sequence of events as described by both drivers. The damage to the front driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle and the rear passenger side of Driver 2's vehicle is consistent with the reported angle and force of impact. Officers confirmed that a Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the crash, and the Passenger was identified at the scene. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. No prior damage to either vehicle was observed or reported. Driver 1 reported a wrist injury and was transported for evaluation. At this time it is not yet clear whether the reported injury resulted from this collision, and that question will require medical review.
